background: Wells Fargo & Company is the holding company of one of the four largest US banks, with consumer banking and lending, commercial banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management, and a long regulatory remediation behind it.
synthesis: Rated A on average across all three, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 29 Sep 2026, the group's credit standing is improving. Capital is the weak spot, with CET1 of 10.3% in the bottom quarter of US banks, though leverage of 5.8% and LCR of 119% are both above the median. CET1 and leverage have each fallen 0.9 points since 30 Jun 2025, while LCR has been broadly flat. The newest flagged item, on 7 Oct 2026, is a federal investigation into its homeownership programmes, set against the upgrade.
